title: 第812章 云梦泽里有什么？
slug: 宗门收徒我能看见属性词条
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

波罗的分身化作一片白泥一般的物质瘫软在地。

这东西天衍宗已经研究过了，材质算不上特殊，只是制造的手法稍有些不同，算不得什么稀奇的手段。

几道虹光飞至白玄灵身侧，三位大乘境修士，两位渡劫境修士。

他们神识扫过，周身灵力震荡，目光也自然而然的锁定了下方化作白泥的分身。

白玄灵轻轻颔首示意无事，随后腰间一柄长剑出鞘，剑锋威压而下，直直穿向下方的潭水之中。

剑意虽然锐利至极，但是操控的却分毫不差。

推开潭水，露出了下方最深处正在静谧流没有任何灵力波动的血红色阵法仪轨。

阵法梵文星罗密布，其中大部分是白玄灵从未见过的构筑形式。

观摩片刻，白玄灵将下方阵法仪轨尽数

“用血气驱动吗？”白玄灵低声念了一句，随后目光望向驰援而来的修士道，“下方阵法诸位自行留下拓本，有劳诸位我位跑一趟了。”

“客气话我就暂时不说了，我还有事。”

“剩下的事情诸位可自行安排。”

白玄灵言毕，微微拱手态度端正的行礼。

众人眼见名声在外，以火爆脾气和一言不发见人就砍著称的活阎王白玄灵这番端正姿态，不管如何去说，也都会觉得面前的白玄灵的确礼貌至极了。

回礼一番，众人共答明了。

白玄灵也未在迟疑，身形化作虹光飞拔而去。

————————

北俱芦洲，云梦泽。

云泽洞天内，云泽神神色谦卑至极，动作紧张且僵硬的坐在了侧位之上。

纵然连郑昭灵来了也没让的主位，今日却让一个面容俊俏的青年男子坐的稳当。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Polo's clone turned into a white mud-like substance and collapsed to the ground.

The Tianyan Sect has already studied this thing. The material is not special, but the manufacturing method is slightly different. It is not a strange method.

Several rays of rainbow light flew to Bai Xuanling's side, three Mahayana monks and two Tribulation Realm monks.

Their consciousness swept over them, their spiritual energy shook, and their eyes naturally locked onto the clone below that turned into white mud.

Bai Xuanling nodded gently to indicate that nothing was wrong, then a long sword was unsheathed at his waist, and the sword edge came down with force, straight through the pool below.

Although the sword intention is extremely sharp, the control is flawless.

Pushing away the pool water, a blood-red formation ritual was revealed in the deepest part below, quietly flowing without any spiritual power fluctuations.

The Sanskrit formations are densely covered with stars, and most of them are structures that Bai Xuanling has never seen before.

After observing for a moment, Bai Xuanling completed all the formation rituals below.

"Is it driven by blood energy?" Bai Xuanling muttered in a low voice, then looked at the monks who came for help and said, "Everyone in the formation below can leave the rubbings for you. If you can help me, I'll take a trip."

"I won't say any polite words for now, I have something else to do."

"You can arrange the rest by yourself."

After Bai Xuanling finished speaking, he slightly raised his hands and saluted with a dignified attitude.

When everyone saw the upright posture of Bai Xuanling, the King of Hell, who was famous for his fiery temper and the ability to kill people without saying a word, no matter how they said it, they would feel that the Bai Xuanling in front of them was indeed extremely polite.

After returning the gift, everyone answered clearly.

Bai Xuanling didn't hesitate, and his body turned into a rainbow and flew away.

————————

The northern end is Luzhou and Yunmengze.

In Yunze Cave, God Yunze looked extremely humble, and he sat on the side seat nervously and stiffly.

Even though Zheng Zhaoling did not give up the main seat even when he came, today a handsome young man was seated securely.
